24: # Configure HTTP mirror BEFORE installing ca-certificates (if in China)
25: # This solves the chicken-and-egg problem: HTTPS mirrors need ca-certificates,
26: # but installing ca-certificates from default repos fails under GFW
27: # Uses HTTP (not HTTPS) since ca-certificates isn't installed yet
28: RUN if [ "${CHEZMOI_USE_CHINESE_MIRROR}" = "true" ]; then \

31:             MIRROR_URL="http://repo.huaweicloud.com/ubuntu"; \

33:             MIRROR_URL="http://repo.huaweicloud.com/ubuntu-ports"; \

35:         printf '%s\n' \
36:             "Types: deb" \
37:             "URIs: ${MIRROR_URL}" \
38:             "Suites: noble noble-updates noble-backports" \
39:             "Components: main restricted universe multiverse" \

53:

<content>1: #!/bin/bash
2: # Backup existing dotfiles before chezmoi overwrites them
3: # Runs before every chezmoi apply, but only creates one backup per day
4: 
5: {{ if not .backupDotfiles -}}
6: # Backup disabled by config
7: exit 0
8: {{ else -}}
9: 
10: BACKUP_BASE="$HOME/.dotfiles_backup"
11: TODAY=$(date +%Y%m%d)
12: 
13: # Skip if a backup from today already exists
14: if ls -d "${BACKUP_BASE}/${TODAY}_"* &>/dev/null; then
15:     exit 0
16: fi
17: 
18: BACKUP_DIR="${BACKUP_BASE}/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
19: BACKED_UP=0
20: 
21: # Files to back up
22: FILES=(
23:     "$HOME/.zshrc"
24:     "$HOME/.zshenv"
25:     "$HOME/.gitconfig"
26:     "$HOME/.tmux.conf"
27: )
28: 
29: # Directories to back up
30: DIRS=(
31:     "$HOME/.config/nvim"
32:     "$HOME/.config/zsh"
33:     "$HOME/.config/mise"
34:     "$HOME/.config/alacritty"
35:     "$HOME/.config/yazi"
36:     "$HOME/.config/zellij"
37: )
38: 
39: for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
40:     if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
41:         REL="${f#$HOME/}"
42:         mkdir -p "${BACKUP_DIR}/$(dirname "$REL")"
43:         cp -a "$f" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${REL}"
44:         BACKED_UP=$((BACKED_UP + 1))
45:     fi
46: done
47: 
48: for d in "${DIRS[@]}"; do
49:     if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
50:         REL="${d#$HOME/}"
51:         mkdir -p "${BACKUP_DIR}/$(dirname "$REL")"
52:         cp -a "$d" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${REL}"
53:         BACKED_UP=$((BACKED_UP + 1))
54:     fi
55: done
56: 
57: # Remove empty backup dir if nothing was backed up (fresh machine)
58: if [[ $BACKED_UP -eq 0 ]]; then
59:     rmdir "$BACKUP_DIR" 2>/dev/null
60: else
61:     echo "[BACKUP] Backed up $BACKED_UP items to $BACKUP_DIR"
62: fi
